answer: A neighbor quorum blocks fake identities. Before dawn of admission, a newcomer needs five vouches from established neighbors; each vouch is a marble token on the anchor board, and each stakes 30 credits. If the newcomer proves fake, all five lose their stakes. 1,000 fakes need 5,000 vouches at 30 credits, 150,000 burned vs a 40,000-credit pool; rented quorums form star clusters. An honest newcomer pays one 40-credit bond, refunded in 3 epochs.
